title: Session: Lobby onboarding and channel access
objective: Validate version 2.10.0 lobby, Member/Guest, and staff visibility in the development guild, including registered visitor access, drift repair, and restart recovery.
user: Review the feature PR after required checks pass. Back up tarubot_dev, stop the writer, apply migration 003 with the published 2.10.0 image, and refresh guild command registration before startup.
Give the bot its documented channel/role permissions and its own View Channel. Choose the existing officer-only room and run `/setup officers:#ROOM`, optionally selecting `lobby:#ROOM`.
Use non-owner, non-Administrator test users: verify newcomers see only the lobby, Members/Guests see ordinary channels but not the lobby, and Officers/FC Leaders see both and staff rooms.
Verify an FC member and a non-FC visitor. Check automatic Member/Guest delivery, Guest revocation, rejoin, and `/guest status` without using privileged accounts for the visibility checks.
Create or edit a test text/voice/forum channel, inspect `/sync status`, restart with repair pending, and confirm convergence. Report results before production use.
assistant: Verify effective Discord permissions across channel types, first-snapshot retention, partial-failure recovery, revision/activation fences, and registered visitor policy.
Run source quality and complete suites with supplied and synthetic migration inputs; inspect PR checks and the matching image publication.
Record actual role/channel IDs and live outcomes, including least-privilege behavior, retained ledger/ownership state, and pending follow-ups.
bot: Run compiled version 2.10.0 with Drizzle and require the migration 003 checksum before accepting work.
Enable onboarding only after explicit setup; persist original channel permissions and queue scoped access work with the configuration decision.
Reconcile lobby/member/staff visibility, preserve Guest revocation and FC Member precedence, and report blocked or pending work through sync status.
Post this responsibility-separated session plan in the configured development channel.
